# Brazilian Fashion & Beauty Blog - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
Full-stack blogging platform focused on Brazilian fashion and beauty content with vibrant, culturally-infused design.

## Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 14, React, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB
- Features: Blog CRUD, image uploads, admin panel, social media integration
